benchmarkDetail.summary: This page shows the currently stored benchmark dataset for one algorithm. It exposes raw timing data by language and input size, plus any benchmark snapshot metadata published by CI.
benchmarkDetail.generatedSummary: Auto summary: the strongest overall workload is {{bestProfile}} ({{bestScore}}), the weakest is {{weakestProfile}} ({{weakestScore}}), and the fastest {{size}} result currently comes from {{fastestLanguage}} at {{fastestTime}}.
benchmarkDetail.pythonLargeCanceled: Python large-size benchmark runs are intentionally canceled for this benchmark.
benchmarkDetail.compositeDescription: A normalized summary of the current stored benchmark profile for this algorithm.
benchmarkDetail.resultsDescription: This algorithm page shows the stored benchmark timings across all supported languages and input sizes.
benchmarkDetail.selectedRankingDescription: Current ranking on the benchmark overview is based on raw time for {{language}} at {{size}} size. Lower is better.
benchmarkDetail.insightStrengthDescription: {{language}} performs best on this workload with a score of {{score}}.
benchmarkDetail.insightWeaknessDescription: {{language}} drops the most on this workload, with a score of {{score}}.
benchmarkDetail.compositeExplanation: Composite score summarizes the full benchmark snapshot. Higher means stronger overall behavior across the stored workload mix.
benchmarkDetail.noPoints: No points or composite score are available yet.
benchmarkDetail.profileDescription: Each dimension shows the stored workload score for the selected language, together with the raw timings for small, medium, and large inputs.
benchmarkDetail.radarHint: Toggle one or more languages to compare their workload shapes on the radar.
benchmarkDetail.allTimingsDescription: This heatmap shows every stored timing by workload profile, language, and input size. Greener cells are faster within the same workload and size slice.
benchmarkDetail.dataDescription: This is the benchmark metadata currently published for this algorithm entry.
benchmarkDetail.snapshotDescription: When CI publishes benchmark metadata, it is shown here together with the harness policy used for the run.
benchmarkDetail.scoreDescription: The schema already reserves space for future score fields, but this benchmark currently ranks by raw time only.
benchmarkDetail.futureDescription: These fields are placeholders for future workload profiles and tiered benchmark views.

elite.title: Very strong
elite.description: This algorithm stays consistently competitive across most measured workloads.

strong.title: Strong overall
strong.description: The benchmark profile is solid, with only a few weaker workload edges.

mixed.title: Specialized tradeoffs
mixed.description: Performance is useful in some workloads, but the profile has noticeable weak spots.

limited.title: Benchmark-limited
limited.description: The stored snapshot shows broad performance weaknesses against the current benchmark set.

unavailable.title: Not enough data
unavailable.description: There is not enough stored score data to draw a reliable verdict yet.
